description: This file defines an abstract class 'ext_soap' that implements SOAP communication within the connector framework of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for converting objects to arrays and serves as a base for subclasses that implement specific SOAP-based data retrieval methods.

classes.name: ext_soap
classes.description: An abstract class providing SOAP implementation details for connector subclasses, including utility methods like obj2array.

methods.name: obj2array
methods.description: Converts an object or array to an array form, recursively handling nested objects and arrays.
